name: Equibles
tagline: US stock market data for Cline: SEC filings, financial statements, earnings calls, insider and 13F holdings
description:
Equibles is a hosted MCP server for US stock market research. Search SEC filings and read the exact source lines, pull XBRL financial statements, earnings call transcripts, insider and congressional trades, 13F institutional holdings, short interest, end-of-day prices and FRED macro data. It has 130 tools: 120 read market data, and 10 write to your own Equibles portfolios, watchlist or feedback, so Cline should only call those when you ask for that change.

Sign-in is OAuth in the browser with your Equibles account, so there is no key to paste. The free plan includes 100 requests a day and needs no credit card; option chains and live quotes need a paid plan.

Docs: https://equibles.com/docs/mcp

install.notes: To use an API key instead of OAuth, create one at https://equibles.com/dashboard/apikeys and install with the plain endpoint https://mcp.equibles.com/mcp and --header "Authorization: Bearer <key>".
